title: USF Environment Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for environment class declarations. Records the execution context (environment-classes) and the provider modes (provider-modes) it permits, keeping environment distinct from provider mode. Enforces that production-shaped MUST NOT satisfy a production-live claim and that an environment name is not itself a readiness claim. Governs the ontology concepts Environment and Provider Mode. lifecycleState draft; not active.

allOf.$comment: production-shaped MUST NOT satisfy a production-live claim.
A production-live claim requires the environment to actually be production-live; environment does not upgrade by implication.
